9	/-!
10	# A multiplication presentation of a reading ideal
11	
12	The second-window route produces a finite multiplication presentation
13	`S ⊗ K → K'`.  This file records the small algebraic step needed before any
14	geometric specialization: if the readings of `K'` are the products of the
15	readings of `S` and `K`, and the product map is onto, then the ideal generated
16	by the `K'` readings is the ideal generated by the `K` readings, provided the
17	multiplier window contains a section reading `1`.
18	
19	The statement is intentionally map-shaped.  It does not identify a concrete
20	theta multiplication map, and it does not infer purity from an `R`-linear
21	range.  A separate hypothesis that the quotient by the *second-window* ideal
22	is `R`-flat can then be transported to the first-window ideal and fed to the
23	genuine ideal-purity consumer.
24	-/
25	
26	set_option autoImplicit false
27	
28	universe u
29	
30	open scoped TensorProduct
31	
32	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
33	
34	namespace IdealPurity
35	
36	variable {R B S K K' : Type u}
37	variable [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
38	variable [AddCommGroup S] [Module R S]
39	variable [AddCommGroup K] [Module R K]
40	variable [AddCommGroup K'] [Module R K']
41	
42	/-! ## The product reading map -/
43	
44	/-- The `R`-linear product of two `B`-valued reading maps. -/
45	noncomputable def productReadMap
46	    (m : S →ₗ[R] B) (r : K →ₗ[R] B) :
47	    S ⊗[R] K →ₗ[R] B :=
48	  (LinearMap.mul' R B).comp (TensorProduct.map m r)
49	
50	@[simp]
51	theorem productReadMap_tmul
52	    (m : S →ₗ[R] B) (r : K →ₗ[R] B) (s : S) (k : K) :
53	    productReadMap (R := R) m r (s ⊗ₜ[R] k) = m s * r k := by
54	  rfl
55	
56	private theorem productReadMap_mem_span_range
57	    (m : S →ₗ[R] B) (r : K →ₗ[R] B) (x : S ⊗[R] K) :
58	    productReadMap (R := R) m r x ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range r) := by
59	  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
60	  | zero => exact Ideal.zero_mem _
61	  | add x y hx hy =>
62	      simpa only [map_add] using Ideal.add_mem _ hx hy
63	  | tmul s k =>
64	      rw [productReadMap_tmul]
65	      exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨k, rfl⟩)
66	
67	/-! ## Equality of the first- and second-window reading ideals -/
68	
69	/-- A surjective multiplication presentation gives the inclusion of the
70	second-window reading ideal in the first-window reading ideal. -/
71	theorem span_range_read_le_of_surjective_mul
72	    (m : S →ₗ[R] B) (r : K →ₗ[R] B) (r' : K' →ₗ[R] B)
73	    (μ : S ⊗[R] K →ₗ[R] K')
74	    (hsurj : Function.Surjective μ)
75	    (hread : ∀ x, r' (μ x) = productReadMap (R := R) m r x) :
76	    Ideal.span (Set.range r') ≤ Ideal.span (Set.range r) := by
77	  refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
78	  rintro _ ⟨k', rfl⟩
79	  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hsurj k'
80	  rw [← hx, hread]
81	  exact productReadMap_mem_span_range (R := R) m r x
82	
83	/-- If the multiplier window contains a unit reading and its product with `K`
84	is represented in `K'`, the two generated reading ideals are equal.
85	
86	The section `ι k` is explicit because the relative theta multiplication map may
87	carry an ambient reindexing or a coherence unit; callers can provide the exact
88	map-level equality they have proved instead of relying on definitional equality.
89	-/
90	theorem span_range_read_eq_of_surjective_mul_of_unit
91	    (m : S →ₗ[R] B) (r : K →ₗ[R] B) (r' : K' →ₗ[R] B)
92	    (μ : S ⊗[R] K →ₗ[R] K')
93	    (hsurj : Function.Surjective μ)
94	    (hread : ∀ x, r' (μ x) = productReadMap (R := R) m r x)
95	    (s₁ : S) (hmunit : IsUnit (m s₁))
96	    (ι : K → K')
97	    (hι : ∀ k, μ (s₁ ⊗ₜ[R] k) = ι k) :
98	    Ideal.span (Set.range r') = Ideal.span (Set.range r) := by
99	  apply le_antisymm
100	  · exact span_range_read_le_of_surjective_mul (R := R) m r r' μ hsurj hread
101	  · refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
102	    rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
103	    have hprod : r' (ι k) = m s₁ * r k := by
104	      rw [← hι k, hread, productReadMap_tmul]
105	    have hmem : m s₁ * r k ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range r') := by
106	      rw [← hprod]
107	      exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨ι k, rfl⟩
108	    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hmunit
109	    rw [← hu] at hmem
110	    have hinv := Ideal.mul_mem_left (Ideal.span (Set.range r')) ((u⁻¹ : Bˣ) : B) hmem
111	    change r k ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range r')
112	    simpa only [← mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, Units.val_one, one_mul] using hinv
113	
114	/-! ## Flatness and purity after the equality -/
115	
116	/-- Flatness of the quotient by the second-window reading ideal transfers to
117	the quotient by the first-window reading ideal. -/
118	theorem flat_quotient_span_range_read_of_surjective_mul_of_unit
119	    (m : S →ₗ[R] B) (r : K →ₗ[R] B) (r' : K' →ₗ[R] B)
120	    (μ : S ⊗[R] K →ₗ[R] K')
121	    (hsurj : Function.Surjective μ)
122	    (hread : ∀ x, r' (μ x) = productReadMap (R := R) m r x)
123	    (s₁ : S) (hmunit : IsUnit (m s₁))
124	    (ι : K → K')
125	    (hι : ∀ k, μ (s₁ ⊗ₜ[R] k) = ι k)
126	    [Module.Flat R (B ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range r'))] :
127	    Module.Flat R (B ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range r)) := by
128	  have hJ := span_range_read_eq_of_surjective_mul_of_unit
129	    (R := R) m r r' μ hsurj hread s₁ hmunit ι hι
130	  rw [← hJ]
131	  infer_instance
132	
133	/-- The corresponding universal injectivity statement for the first-window
134	ideal.  This is the direct consumer for a residue-field `hspan` argument. -/
135	theorem subtype_rTensor_injective_span_range_read_of_surjective_mul_of_unit
136	    (m : S →ₗ[R] B) (r : K →ₗ[R] B) (r' : K' →ₗ[R] B)
137	    (μ : S ⊗[R] K →ₗ[R] K')
138	    (hsurj : Function.Surjective μ)
139	    (hread : ∀ x, r' (μ x) = productReadMap (R := R) m r x)
140	    (s₁ : S) (hmunit : IsUnit (m s₁))
141	    (ι : K → K')
142	    (hι : ∀ k, μ (s₁ ⊗ₜ[R] k) = ι k)
143	    [Module.Flat R (B ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range r'))]
144	    (A : Type u) [AddCommGroup A] [Module R A] :
145	    Function.Injective
146	      (LinearMap.rTensor (R := R) A
147	        ((Ideal.span (Set.range r)).restrictScalars R).subtype) := by
148	  haveI : Module.Flat R (B ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range r)) := by
149	    exact flat_quotient_span_range_read_of_surjective_mul_of_unit
150	      (R := R) m r r' μ hsurj hread s₁ hmunit ι hι
151	  exact subtype_rTensor_injective_of_flat_quotient
152	    (R := R) (B := B) (Ideal.span (Set.range r)) A
153	
154	end IdealPurity

20	theta multiplication map, and it does not infer purity from an `R`-linear

46	    (m : S →ₗ[R] B) (r : K →ₗ[R] B) :
47	    S ⊗[R] K →ₗ[R] B :=

121	    (hsurj : Function.Surjective μ)

9	/-!
10	# A multiplication presentation of a reading ideal
11	
12	The second-window route produces a finite multiplication presentation
13	`S ⊗ K → K'`.  This file records the small algebraic step needed before any
14	geometric specialization: if the readings of `K'` are the products of the
15	readings of `S` and `K`, and the product map is onto, then the ideal generated
16	by the `K'` readings is the ideal generated by the `K` readings, provided the
17	multiplier window contains a section reading `1`.
18	
19	The statement is intentionally map-shaped.  It does not identify a concrete
20	theta multiplication map, and it does not infer purity from an `R`-linear
21	range.  A separate hypothesis that the quotient by the *second-window* ideal
22	is `R`-flat can then be transported to the first-window ideal and fed to the
23	genuine ideal-purity consumer.
24	-/

42	/-! ## The product reading map -/
43	
44	/-- The `R`-linear product of two `B`-valued reading maps. -/
45	noncomputable def productReadMap
46	    (m : S →ₗ[R] B) (r : K →ₗ[R] B) :
47	    S ⊗[R] K →ₗ[R] B :=
48	  (LinearMap.mul' R B).comp (TensorProduct.map m r)
49	
50	@[simp]
51	theorem productReadMap_tmul
52	    (m : S →ₗ[R] B) (r : K →ₗ[R] B) (s : S) (k : K) :
53	    productReadMap (R := R) m r (s ⊗ₜ[R] k) = m s * r k := by
54	  rfl
55	
56	private theorem productReadMap_mem_span_range
57	    (m : S →ₗ[R] B) (r : K →ₗ[R] B) (x : S ⊗[R] K) :
58	    productReadMap (R := R) m r x ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range r) := by
59	  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
60	  | zero => exact Ideal.zero_mem _
61	  | add x y hx hy =>
62	      simpa only [map_add] using Ideal.add_mem _ hx hy
63	  | tmul s k =>
64	      rw [productReadMap_tmul]
65	      exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨k, rfl⟩)
66	
67	/-! ## Equality of the first- and second-window reading ideals -/
68	
69	/-- A surjective multiplication presentation gives the inclusion of the
70	second-window reading ideal in the first-window reading ideal. -/
71	theorem span_range_read_le_of_surjective_mul
72	    (m : S →ₗ[R] B) (r : K →ₗ[R] B) (r' : K' →ₗ[R] B)
73	    (μ : S ⊗[R] K →ₗ[R] K')
74	    (hsurj : Function.Surjective μ)
75	    (hread : ∀ x, r' (μ x) = productReadMap (R := R) m r x) :
76	    Ideal.span (Set.range r') ≤ Ideal.span (Set.range r) := by
77	  refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
78	  rintro _ ⟨k', rfl⟩
79	  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hsurj k'
80	  rw [← hx, hread]
81	  exact productReadMap_mem_span_range (R := R) m r x
82	
83	/-- If the multiplier window contains a unit reading and its product with `K`
84	is represented in `K'`, the two generated reading ideals are equal.
85	
86	The section `ι k` is explicit because the relative theta multiplication map may
87	carry an ambient reindexing or a coherence unit; callers can provide the exact
88	map-level equality they have proved instead of relying on definitional equality.
89	-/
90	theorem span_range_read_eq_of_surjective_mul_of_unit
91	    (m : S →ₗ[R] B) (r : K →ₗ[R] B) (r' : K' →ₗ[R] B)
92	    (μ : S ⊗[R] K →ₗ[R] K')
93	    (hsurj : Function.Surjective μ)
94	    (hread : ∀ x, r' (μ x) = productReadMap (R := R) m r x)
95	    (s₁ : S) (hmunit : IsUnit (m s₁))
96	    (ι : K → K')
97	    (hι : ∀ k, μ (s₁ ⊗ₜ[R] k) = ι k) :
98	    Ideal.span (Set.range r') = Ideal.span (Set.range r) := by
99	  apply le_antisymm
100	  · exact span_range_read_le_of_surjective_mul (R := R) m r r' μ hsurj hread
101	  · refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
102	    rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
103	    have hprod : r' (ι k) = m s₁ * r k := by
104	      rw [← hι k, hread, productReadMap_tmul]
105	    have hmem : m s₁ * r k ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range r') := by
106	      rw [← hprod]
107	      exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨ι k, rfl⟩
108	    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hmunit
109	    rw [← hu] at hmem
110	    have hinv := Ideal.mul_mem_left (Ideal.span (Set.range r')) ((u⁻¹ : Bˣ) : B) hmem
111	    change r k ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range r')
112	    simpa only [← mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, Units.val_one, one_mul] using hinv
113	
114	/-! ## Flatness and purity after the equality -/
115	
116	/-- Flatness of the quotient by the second-window reading ideal transfers to
117	the quotient by the first-window reading ideal. -/
118	theorem flat_quotient_span_range_read_of_surjective_mul_of_unit
119	    (m : S →ₗ[R] B) (r : K →ₗ[R] B) (r' : K' →ₗ[R] B)
120	    (μ : S ⊗[R] K →ₗ[R] K')
121	    (hsurj : Function.Surjective μ)
122	    (hread : ∀ x, r' (μ x) = productReadMap (R := R) m r x)
123	    (s₁ : S) (hmunit : IsUnit (m s₁))
124	    (ι : K → K')
125	    (hι : ∀ k, μ (s₁ ⊗ₜ[R] k) = ι k)
126	    [Module.Flat R (B ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range r'))] :
127	    Module.Flat R (B ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range r)) := by
128	  have hJ := span_range_read_eq_of_surjective_mul_of_unit
129	    (R := R) m r r' μ hsurj hread s₁ hmunit ι hι
130	  rw [← hJ]
131	  infer_instance
132	
133	/-- The corresponding universal injectivity statement for the first-window
134	ideal.  This is the direct consumer for a residue-field `hspan` argument. -/
135	theorem subtype_rTensor_injective_span_range_read_of_surjective_mul_of_unit
136	    (m : S →ₗ[R] B) (r : K →ₗ[R] B) (r' : K' →ₗ[R] B)
137	    (μ : S ⊗[R] K →ₗ[R] K')
138	    (hsurj : Function.Surjective μ)
139	    (hread : ∀ x, r' (μ x) = productReadMap (R := R) m r x)
140	    (s₁ : S) (hmunit : IsUnit (m s₁))
141	    (ι : K → K')
142	    (hι : ∀ k, μ (s₁ ⊗ₜ[R] k) = ι k)
143	    [Module.Flat R (B ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range r'))]
144	    (A : Type u) [AddCommGroup A] [Module R A] :
145	    Function.Injective
146	      (LinearMap.rTensor (R := R) A
147	        ((Ideal.span (Set.range r)).restrictScalars R).subtype) := by
148	  haveI : Module.Flat R (B ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range r)) := by
149	    exact flat_quotient_span_range_read_of_surjective_mul_of_unit
150	      (R := R) m r r' μ hsurj hread s₁ hmunit ι hι
151	  exact subtype_rTensor_injective_of_flat_quotient
152	    (R := R) (B := B) (Ideal.span (Set.range r)) A
153
